summary: NatWest Group plc filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5), Reg. No. 333-284008) dated October 13, 2026 for an offering of senior callable fixed-to-fixed reset rate notes due 20__, issued off its December 23, 2024 shelf. The notes bear an initial fixed rate through a reset date, then a U.S. Treasury Rate plus a spread, paid semi-annually, with optional whole-not-part redemption at 100% plus accrued interest and tax/regulatory calls; they are direct, unsecured, unsubordinated obligations and expressly subject to UK bail-in powers. Terms, size and pricing are left blank. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation.
